change: Criterion 13 now defines the transition for inherited ledger duties: an order filed before 2026-09-09 whose acceptance text names a ledger entry discharges it with its decisions file and its row in the generated decisions index, checked by the verifier and marked by the work-order index, so no executor decides it alone; WO-084 is the one permitted historical migration and preserves every entry's prose byte for byte; the never-rewritten rule binds lifecycle sessions, not that migration.
